text:
maria: Quick sync — starting an RFC for tenant audit log access controls. Need rapid feedback on RBAC scoping, scoped tokens, and customer-facing audit event validation. TL;DR: default to admin-only visibility, allow member-scoped exports via scoped tokens with KMS-wrapped export keys. Thoughts?

alex: +1 to admin-only by default. For exports: do we sign bundles, encrypt them, or both? KMS integration will shape this. :thinking_face:

jamal: We should add a `visibility` enum to events: values = `tenant_admin`, `org_member`, `internal`. UI + APIs can filter based on that. Also add `redaction_level` so we know if PII was stripped.

elaine: Performance note: large tenants have millions of events. We should avoid additional heavy indexes. Can we rely on (tenant_id, created_at) and do visibility filtering in app layer?

maria: Good point. Proposal: keep DB index on (tenant_id, created_at) only. Visibility enforced at read-time using scoped token claims and service-layer checks. For exports, sign with tenant-specific KMS key so customers can validate integrity.

sre-bot: Deploy job failed: export-job-2024-11-03 for tenant=acme-corp exited 1. Logs: `S3 error 403` — retrying.

alex: Scoped tokens design: tokens carry `allowed_visibility` claim and short TTL. Example JWT claim: "vis": ["tenant_admin"]. Token issuance must check requester role.

jamal: Example minimal event schema (proto/JSON) to discuss: 
```
{
  "event_id": "e-123",
  "schema_version": "2",
  "event_type": "config.change",
  "tenant_id": "t-acme",
  "actor_id": "u-42",
  "actor_role": "member",
  "visibility": "tenant_admin",
  "redaction_level": "pii-stripped",
  "payload": { /* opaque json */ },
  "signed_by": "projects/keys/t-acme/key-1"
}
```

elaine: For KMS we need per-tenant keys (or per-tenant key-wrapping keys). Ops will need rotation, IAM bindings, and audit logs. Who owns key lifecycle?

maria: Ops owns rotation & KMS provisioning; sec owns the access policy templates and reviews. We should draft a runbook: key creation, rotation cadence, emergency revoke.

jamal: Also: include `schema_version` field so we can evolve visibility semantics without breaking old consumers. Consumers should reject unknown versions.

maria: Agreed. Action items: 1) iam/roles doc for audit-log reads + scoped token semantics (owner: alex), 2) audit schema PR with versioning + `visibility` & `redaction_level` (owner: jamal), 3) export signing POC using tenant KMS keys (owner: maria/ops). I'll create a short RFC doc and link it here.

alex: I'll draft the IAM roles doc and post a PR by EOD.

jamal: I'll open the schema PR and add migration notes.

maria: Thanks all. If anyone has objections to admin-only default + scoped token exports, call it out here. Otherwise I'll start the RFC and runbook draft. :thumbsup:
